answer: In this agent economy, each participant maintains a unique biometric pulse of computational work that updates every few seconds, forming an irregular heartbeat signature. A decentralized raven network then relays these pulses as short-lived tokens that peers must re-sign, creating a directed graph of live presence. To mint new identities or scale influence, an agent must first publish a personal fable—a cryptographically chained narrative of past pulse interactions that no batch of sybils can fabricate at once because each fable embeds irreversible commitments from distinct raven relays.
